description: Capability for the needs-you panel (GH #468), a separate always-on-top window. It is not in default.json's "windows", so without this it gets NO permissions at all; its own commands (attention_question/answer/open_task) are app commands and work regardless, but core:event (listen/emit) is capability-gated, and the panel listens for the main window's list of waiting tasks and asks it to resend that list when it opens.
